WITH siparis_2025 AS (
    SELECT s.id, m.ad, s.tarih
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN musteriler m ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    WHERE s.tarih LIKE '2025%'
),
siparis_kalem_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sk.siparis_id,
        u.ad as urun_ad,
        u.kategori,
        sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat as toplam_fiyat
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    JOIN urunler u ON sk.urun_id = u.id
    WHERE sk.siparis_id IN (SELECT id FROM siparis_2025)
),
toplam_ciro AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(toplam_fiyat) as ciro,
        COUNT(*) as satilan_adet
    FROM siparis_kalem_2025
    GROUP BY kategori
),
ciro_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.kategori,
        ROUND(tc.ciro * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(tc.ciro) OVER (), 0), 1) as yüzde,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.ciro DESC) as sıra
    FROM toplam_ciro tc
)
SELECT 
    kategori,
    ciro,
    yüzde,
    sıra
FROM ciro_with_rank
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    '0' as kategori,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    999
ORDER BY kategori ASC;
